method: Outcomes collapsed to burn (burned, flame_spread, completed, disruption) vs no-burn (extinguished, self_extinguished, no_ignition); rows with other outcomes are skipped. Prediction = inverse-distance-weighted kNN (k=5, power 2) in normalized O2/pressure/flow space with fuel-phase, material and gravity penalties (src/lib/evidence.ts). Every accuracy is reported with a majority-class baseline (always predict the most common outcome of the same set of tests) and its n. Numeric targets use the same distance and status rules (kNN regression).

backtests.name: leave-one-test-out
backtests.description: Each test is hidden in turn and its burn / no-burn outcome is predicted from all other tests, including near-identical replicates of the same investigation (which is why most answers are "Measured").

backtests.name: leave-one-test-out-grouped
backtests.description: As leave-one-test-out, but when a test is hidden, every test of the same investigation within the Measured tolerance (same phase and material, ±0.6% O2, ±3 kPa, ±2 cm/s) is hidden with it, so the model cannot copy a replicate.

backtests.name: leave-one-investigation-out
backtests.description: Hide an experiment: all tests of one investigation are removed and each is estimated from the other investigations only. Strict accuracy counts correct predictions only. Flagging rate = share of the wrong answers that the system had labelled Extrapolated (it warned you). Baselines: majority outcome of the hidden tests (pooled) and majority outcome of the other investigations.
